decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric has its own page, a sign of strong commitment, and its prospects are still uncertain after only one year while keeping it in a broad collection costs little.
It is only mentioned on the website, so the firm's commitment is weaker, but one year is too early to judge its value and a fabric made by production partners is cheap to keep listed.
This flame-retardant jacquard serves contract and hospitality demand, has a dedicated page and offers durable project potential, so the option is worth keeping open.
The wool-blend double-face fabric fits the firm's shift toward renewable materials, and its value is still unresolved, so it should be kept at low cost.
This wool bouclé leno overlaps with Product B within the firm's many options, which makes it a candidate to prune later, but there is not yet enough evidence to abandon it.
